heading: Table 2 Recommended dosages of drugs for the treatment of LTBI
data: Isoniazid alone, daily for 6 or 9 months
Daily isoniazid plus rifampicin for 3–4 months
Isoniazid: Adults, 5 mg Children, 10 mg (range, 7–15 mg) Rifampicin Adults, 10 mg Children, 15 mg (range, 10–20 mg)
Weekly rifapentine plus isoniazid for 3 months (12 doses)

Individuals aged ≥ 12 years: Isoniazid: 15 mg Individuals aged 2–11 years: isoniazid: 25 mg Rifapentine: 10.0–14.0 kg = 300 mg 14.1–25.0 kg = 450 mg 25.1–32.0 kg = 600 mg 32.1–50.0 kg = 750 mg > 50 kg = 900 mg
